*   `?g A13`: Main Concept (group g) is A13 (Game / Toy).
    *   `+ B11`: Sub-Concept (group g) is B11 (Aircraft / Aerial / Flying).

    *   A13: Game/Toy (Teddy bear, die, cards, army man).
    *   B11: Aircraft/Aerial/Flying (Airplane, helicopter).
